answer_1.quote: We propose the Chat Game Engine (ChatGE), powered by LLMs. This engine is designed to support the development of custom games using natural language through Human-LLM interaction.
answer_1.outputs: natural language guidance, game script segments, and code snippets in a multi-turn interaction

answer_2.quote: We evaluate code correctness using two functional-level metrics and two overall-level metrics...

answer_3.quote: We utilize GPT-4o as the evaluator, run 5 times and average the results.
methods: scoring system based on definitive scale from 1 to 4

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation study to validate the reliability of LLM assessments. A total of 20 human volunteers with no experience in game development are required to interact with the model and evaluate the Interaction Quality across 10 test cases.
answer_4.guideline: Participants evaluated Interaction Quality across multiple dimensions as outlined in Table 3, including guidance, logic, relevance, coherence, and conciseness.
